evals.prompt: The login endpoint started returning 500s about three days ago. It was working last week. Find what changed, when, and why.
evals.expected_output: A precise symptom with a last-good time, a narrowed window of candidates, and the change that explains the symptom with evidence.
expectations: States the symptom precisely with a last-good time
Narrows the window using commits, deploys, dependency bumps, and config changes
Inspects the actual diff of candidates rather than guessing
Prefers the change that explains the symptom over one that is merely nearby
Reports the cause with the evidence that links it to the symptom

evals.prompt: Search results have been slow since the deploy last Tuesday. What caused it?
evals.expected_output: Uses the deploy window to find the candidate change and links it to the slowdown with evidence.
expectations: Uses the stated deploy window to narrow candidates
Identifies the change that touches the search code path
Links the change to the symptom with evidence
Says so if no single change explains it
